author: Lisa Ramage
content: We hired the D ball pond and the orange package for my daughter's christening/1st birthday. The staff in the office were approachable and helpful, with quick email responses to any queries we had. The delivery was on time and the set-up looked great. The condition of the soft play was immaculate, and the kids absolutely loved the party. We would highly recommend Dancing Cubs and will certainly use them again in the future!
